SGPGI Nursing Officer and Non Teaching Post Admit Card 2026

Post Date: June 17, 2026

5:30 pm

Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGI), has released the Admit Card for the recruitment of Nursing Officer and Non Teaching Post on its official website. The Exam will be conducted on 19 – 23 June 2026, The SGPGI application process started on 18 June 2025, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 31 July 2025. Candidates can check their Admit Card using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
